title: Packet-first agent protocol

claims.text: Agent read order: control_error, instructions, agent_protocol.state, evidence path:line, organism, claim_boundary.

CLI activate, ritual, organism, breathe, MCP cortex_* tools, and wrappers must speak the same agent_protocol.
